support_claim: Although the billing record, contract header, and commercial notes all associate Meridian Energy Partners LLC with MSA-MER-2024, the packet supplies only name overlap and contextual linkage—not establishing identity evidence—so neither SAME_ENTITY nor DISTINCT is warranted.

steps.fact: The left referent is billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC.
The billing record names Meridian Energy Partners LLC as the billed party.
Contract MSA-MER-2024 lists Meridian Energy Partners LLC as its counterparty.
Commercial notes state that Meridian Energy Partners invoices are the advisory retainer under MSA-MER-2024.
The packet provides no shared legal identifier, uniqueness claim, or explicit statement that the billing referent and the contract referent denote the same legal counterparty.
Shared counterparty name and invoice-to-contract association are compatibility signals only and do not satisfy the identity-establishment burden for SAME_ENTITY.
The packet contains no evidence establishing that the two referents are distinct legal counterparties.
